atmosphere.continue.description: The one button for signing in and for creating an account, in every app.

common.back.description: Accessible name of the button that goes to the previous step.

common.close.description: Accessible name of the button that closes the sheet or a dialog.

common.continue.description: Button that goes on to the next step.

identity.hostedBy.description: Under an account: the provider that hosts it. {provider} is the provider's name, such as Bluesky.

email.recovery.codeLifetime.message: The code works for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
email.recovery.codeLifetime.description: Recovery email: how long the sign-in code lasts. {minutes} is a whole number, usually 15.

email.recovery.noLinks.message: We never put a sign-in link in an email. If an email asks you to click to sign in, it isn’t from us.
email.recovery.noLinks.description: Recovery email: teaches people that real sign-in emails never ask them to click.

link.opensInNewTab.description: After a link's text, when the link opens in a new tab, so nobody is surprised by it.

field.errorPrefix.description: Read before a field's error message by screen readers, and hidden on screen. The message itself follows.

password.show.description: Accessible name of the button that shows the password as text.

password.hide.description: Accessible name of the same button once the password is showing.

handle.didYouMean.description: Above a suggested account when what someone typed looks like a slip, such as bsky.app for bsky.social.

handle.readAs.description: Under the handle field when Doras corrected what someone typed. {typed} is what they typed; {handle} is the handle, with its @.

handle.fixAtSign.message: Handles use dots, not an @ in the middle.
handle.fixAtSign.description: Follows handle.readAs when someone typed a handle like an email address, such as sam@bsky.social.

handle.fixEnding.message: {ending} isn’t a handle ending. Handles hosted by {provider} end in {correct}.
handle.fixEnding.description: Follows handle.readAs when someone typed a common mix-up, such as bsky.app. {provider} is the provider's name, such as Bluesky.

handle.fixLink.message: We took the handle from the profile link.
handle.fixLink.description: Follows handle.readAs when someone pasted a profile link.

handle.suggestionCount.message: {count, plural, =0 {No matching accounts} one {# matching account} other {# matching accounts}}
handle.suggestionCount.description: Announced to screen readers as suggestions appear under the handle field.

divider.or.description: Between two ways to do the same thing, such as a password and “Use a passkey”.

permission.why.description: Before the reason an app gives for a permission, on the Connect page.

atmosphere.mark.description: Accessible name of the Atmosphere mark, when it's shown on its own. Never translated.

errorSummary.heading.description: Heading of the error summary at the top of a page with more than one field.

common.tryAgain.description: Button that retries what failed, such as after a network failure.

failure.network.message: We couldn’t connect. Check your internet connection, then try again. What you typed is still here.
failure.network.description: Shown when the network fails. Never blames the person or the app.

failure.tooManyAttempts.message: Too many tries. Wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, then try again.
failure.tooManyAttempts.description: Shown after too many attempts. Never says whether an account exists. {minutes} is a whole number.

failure.sessionExpired.message: This took a while, so we started again to keep your account safe. You can carry on from here.
failure.sessionExpired.description: Shown when a sign-in session expires. Restarts without losing context.

failure.providerUnavailable.message: {provider} isn’t answering right now. It isn’t something you did. Try again in a few minutes.
failure.providerUnavailable.description: Shown when the provider is down. {provider} is its name, such as Bluesky. Doesn't blame the person or the app.

sheet.brand.description: Beside the Atmosphere mark at the top of Front Door's sheet.

providerLink.manage.description: A link to the provider's own account page. {provider} is its name, such as Bluesky.

skipLink.label.description: The first link on a provider page, shown when focused, that skips to the main content.

sheet.foot.message: One Atmosphere account for Bluesky, {app} and every other Atmosphere app.
sheet.foot.description: At the foot of Front Door's sheet. {app} is the app's name, such as Potluck.

provider.label.description: Beside the provider's name at the top of its own pages.

provider.foot.message: This is {provider}’s own page. {provider} hosts your Atmosphere account, and {app} never sees your password.
provider.foot.description: At the foot of a provider's page. {provider} is its name; {app} is the app's name.

common.cancel.description: Button that cancels the current step.

common.notNow.description: Button that turns down an offer for now, such as adding a passkey.

common.checking.description: What a button says while a code is checked.

common.signIn.description: Button that signs in on the provider's page.

common.change.description: Button next to a filled-in handle that goes back to choose another account.

common.email.description: Label of an email address field.

common.password.description: Label of a password field, and the name of the password option.

find.heading.description: Heading of the first step, where people type their handle. {app} is the app's name.

find.lede.message: Use your Atmosphere account. If you use Bluesky or another Atmosphere app, you already have one.
find.lede.description: Under the first heading: says that Bluesky users already have an account.

find.hint.message: It’s on your profile, like {example} or {other}. You can type your name instead.
find.hint.description: Hint under the handle field. {example} and {other} are example handles.

find.submit.description: Button that looks up the handle.

find.busy.description: What the find button says while it looks.

find.forgot.description: Link to finding the account by email.

find.create.message: New here? Create an Atmosphere account

find.errorEmpty.message: Type your handle or your name to find your Atmosphere account.

find.errorEmail.message: That looks like an email address. Handles look like {example}.
find.errorEmail.description: Error when an email address was typed. {example} is an example handle.

find.useEmail.message: Find my account with this email
find.useEmail.description: Button under the email error: finds the account by that email.

find.partial.message: Handles have a dot in them, like {example}. Is it one of these?
find.partial.description: When a name, not a handle, was typed and accounts match. {example} is an example handle.

find.noOne.message: We couldn’t find anyone called “{name}”. Handles look like {example} or {other}.
find.noOne.description: When a name was typed and nobody matches. {name} is what was typed.

find.notFound.message: We couldn’t find {handle}. Check the spelling, or find your account with your email.
find.notFound.description: When a full handle was typed and no account has it. {handle} is the handle.

search.lede.message: Start typing your name or handle. We’ll show matching Atmosphere accounts.

recover.heading.message: Type the handle from the email
recover.heading.description: Heading after the recovery email arrives.

recover.lede.message: Your provider asks for the sign-in code from the same email next.
recover.lede.description: Under the heading: the code comes next.

recover.hint.message: It’s near the top of the email, under “Your handle”.
recover.hint.description: Hint under the field: where to find the handle.

recover.noEmail.description: Link back to the email step.

confirm.heading.description: Heading when an account is found.

confirm.next.description: Heading of what happens next. {provider} hosts the account.

confirm.go.message: You’ll go to {host}. {provider} hosts your Atmosphere account, so that’s where you sign in.
confirm.go.description: First step of what happens next. {host} is the provider's address.

confirm.decide.message: {provider} will show what {app} wants to do. You decide.
confirm.decide.description: Second step: the provider shows the permissions.

confirm.return.message: Then you’ll come straight back to {app}.
confirm.return.description: Third step: back to the app.

confirm.continue.description: Button that goes to the provider's sign-in page.

create.heading.description: Heading of the step where people choose who hosts their new account.

create.alreadyHeading.message: Used Bluesky or another Atmosphere app before?
create.alreadyHeading.description: Heading of the notice that people may already have an account.

create.alreadyBody.message: Then you already have an Atmosphere account, and you can sign in with it.

create.signInWithIt.description: Link in that notice, to sign in instead.

create.searchYourself.description: Link in that notice, to search by name.

create.legend.message: Who should host your Atmosphere account?

create.hint.message: Your provider keeps your Atmosphere account safe and online. It works in every Atmosphere app whichever provider you pick, and you can move to another provider later and take your posts and followers with you, like keeping your number when you change mobile network.
create.hint.description: Explains what a provider is, and that people can move.

create.suggestedBy.description: Tag on the app's own hosting, which it suggests.

create.anotherBlurb.message: Use any provider’s address, or your own server.

create.address.description: Label of the field for another provider's address.

create.addressHint.message: Your provider can tell you what it is.
create.addressHint.description: Hint under the provider address field.

create.addressError.description: Error when the address isn't one. {example} is an example address.

create.continueWith.description: Button that goes to the chosen provider.

provider.blurb.app.message: {app} hosts your Atmosphere account for you. The quickest way to start.
provider.blurb.app.description: Description of the app's own hosting.

provider.blurb.blacksky.message: A community-run home for Black people on the open social web.
provider.blurb.blacksky.description: Placeholder description of Blacksky. Who is listed, and how, is still open.

provider.blurb.bluesky.message: The biggest provider, run by the team behind the Bluesky app.
provider.blurb.bluesky.description: Placeholder description of Bluesky as a provider.

provider.blurb.eurosky.message: Hosted in Europe and open to everyone.

found.heading.message: Before you create an Atmosphere account
found.heading.description: Heading when the browser knows an account the person may already have.

found.kicker.description: Small label above the found account.

found.title.message: You already have an Atmosphere account

found.one.message: This browser knows {name}’s Atmosphere account, hosted by {provider}. It works on {app} too, so there’s no need to make another one.
found.one.description: When the browser knows one account. {name} is the person's name.

found.several.message: This browser knows these Atmosphere accounts. Any of them works on {app}, so there’s no need to make another one.
found.several.description: When the browser knows several accounts.

found.anyway.description: Disclosure that opens the providers after all.

forgot.heading.message: Find your Atmosphere account with your email

forgot.lede.message: The provider that hosts your Atmosphere account can email you your handle and a code to sign in. {app} never finds out whether you have an account.
forgot.lede.description: Explains who emails, and that the app learns nothing.

forgot.legend.message: Which provider hosts your Atmosphere account?

forgot.notSure.description: Option for people who don't know their provider.

forgot.submit.description: Button that asks the provider to email.

forgot.errorEmail.message: Enter the email address you used when you created your Atmosphere account, like {example}.
forgot.errorEmail.description: Error when the email address isn't one. {example} is an example address.

forgot.errorProvider.message: Choose the provider that hosts your account, or choose “Not sure”.
forgot.errorProvider.description: Error when no provider is chosen.

checkEmail.heading.description: Heading after the email is requested.

checkEmail.body.message: If {provider} hosts an Atmosphere account for {email}, it’s emailing your handle and a sign-in code there now.
checkEmail.body.description: Never says whether the account exists. {email} is the address typed.

checkEmail.bodyUnsure.message: If one of the providers we asked hosts an Atmosphere account for {email}, it’s emailing your handle and a sign-in code there now.
checkEmail.bodyUnsure.description: The same, when the person wasn't sure of their provider.

checkEmail.asked.message: We asked {providers}. Only the provider that hosts your account will email you.
checkEmail.asked.description: Which providers were asked. {providers} is a list.

checkEmail.from.message: The email comes from {provider}, not from {app}. It can take a minute or two, and sometimes lands in spam or junk.
checkEmail.from.description: Who sends the email, and where to look.

checkEmail.fromUnsure.message: The email comes from your provider, not from {app}. It can take a minute or two, and sometimes lands in spam or junk.
checkEmail.fromUnsure.description: The same, when the person wasn't sure of their provider.

checkEmail.got.description: Button for when the email has arrived.

checkEmail.another.description: Link back to choose another provider.

signin.heading.message: Sign in to your Atmosphere account
signin.heading.description: Heading of the provider's sign-in page.

signin.lede.message: {provider} hosts your account. Sign in here to continue to {app}.

signin.handle.description: Label of the handle on the provider's page.

signin.forgot.description: Link to signing in with an emailed code.

signin.busy.description: What the sign-in button says while it works.

signin.usePasskey.description: Button that asks the browser for a passkey.

signin.errorEmpty.message: Type your password, or choose “Forgot password?”.
signin.errorEmpty.description: Error when no password was typed.

signin.errorPasskeyOnly.message: This account signs in with a passkey only. Use a passkey, or get a code by email if you can’t.
signin.errorPasskeyOnly.description: Error when an account with “Passkey only” is given a password.

signin.passkeyCancelled.message: Can’t use a passkey? Sign in with your password, or get a code by email.
signin.passkeyCancelled.description: After the passkey prompt is cancelled.

signin.getCode.description: Link that sends a sign-in code by email.

totp.heading.message: Enter the code from your authenticator app
totp.heading.description: Heading of the verification code step.

totp.lede.message: Open the app you set up for {handle} and type the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.lede.description: Under the heading. {handle} is the account's handle.

totp.label.description: Label of the verification code field.

totp.error.message: Type the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.error.description: Error when the code isn't 6 digits.

totp.usePasskey.description: Button that uses a passkey instead of the code.

totp.lostPhone.message: Lost your phone? Get a code by email
totp.lostPhone.description: Link for people without their authenticator app.

offer.signedIn.message: You’re signed in to your Atmosphere account, {handle}.

offer.lede.message: Add a passkey, and next time you can sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of your password. A passkey can’t be phished.

offer.fine.message: Your browser saves it on this device. It works with {provider} in every Atmosphere app.

code.heading.description: Heading of the emailed code step.

code.lede.description: Under the heading. {email} is partly hidden.

code.error.message: That code doesn’t match. Use the code in the latest email from {provider}, or send a new one.
code.error.description: Error when the code is wrong.

code.resend.message: No email? Send a new code
code.resend.description: Link that sends a new code.

code.sent.message: We sent a new code. Use the one in the latest email.
code.sent.description: After a new code is sent.

code.passwordInstead.message: Know your password? Sign in with it instead

nextTime.heading.message: How do you want to sign in next time?
nextTime.heading.description: Heading after signing in with an emailed code.

nextTime.lede.message: Add a passkey, or set a new password. You can also do this later in your account settings on {provider}.

nextTime.lost.message: Your passkey on {device} still works on that device. If it’s lost, remove it so nobody else can use it.
nextTime.lost.description: When a passkey is on a lost device. {device} names it.

nextTime.remove.description: Button that removes the lost passkey.

nextTime.removed.message: The passkey on {device} is removed. It no longer works.
nextTime.removed.description: After the lost passkey is removed.

nextTime.passwordInstead.description: Disclosure that opens the new password field.

nextTime.newPassword.description: Label of the new password field.

nextTime.save.description: Button that saves the new password.

signup.lede.message: {provider} will host it. Use it with {app} and every other Atmosphere app.

signup.legend.message: How do you want to sign in?
signup.legend.description: Question above the passkey and password options.

signup.passkeyBlurb.message: Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock. Nothing to remember.

signup.passwordBlurb.message: Choose a password of at least 8 characters.

signup.passkeyNote.message: Your browser saves the passkey on this device. It works with {provider} in every Atmosphere app. If you ever move your account to another provider, you’ll set up a new passkey there.
signup.passkeyNote.description: Shown when the passkey is chosen.

signup.passwordHint.description: Hint under a new password field.

signup.terms.message: By creating an Atmosphere account hosted by {provider}, you agree to {provider}’s Terms and Privacy Policy.
signup.terms.description: Above the button: the provider's terms.

signup.submit.description: Button that goes to the handle step.

signup.signInInstead.message: Already have an Atmosphere account? Sign in instead

signup.errorEmail.message: Enter an email address, like {example}. You’ll use it if you ever need to get back into your account.
signup.errorEmail.description: Error when the email address isn't one.

signup.errorMethod.message: Choose a passkey or a password.
signup.errorMethod.description: Error when no way to sign in is chosen.

signup.errorPassword.description: Error when the password is too short.

signup.passkeyCancelled.message: No passkey was made. Try again, or choose a password.
signup.passkeyCancelled.description: After the passkey prompt is cancelled during sign-up.

newHandle.lede.message: It’s how people find you on {app}, Bluesky and other Atmosphere apps. You can change it later.

newHandle.label.description: Label of the new handle field.

newHandle.ending.description: Hint under the handle field. {ending} is the provider's ending.

newHandle.taken.description: When the handle is taken. {suggestion} is a free one.

newHandle.errorChars.message: Use letters, numbers and hyphens only.

newHandle.errorLength.description: Error when the handle is too short or long.

newHandle.errorName.description: Error when no name was typed.

newHandle.busy.description: What the button says while it works.

connect.notYou.description: Link that goes back to choose another account.

connect.can.description: Heading of what the app can do.

connect.cannot.description: Heading of what the app can't do.

connect.neverPassword.description: Something the app can never do.

connect.neverMessages.description: Something the app can't do here.

connect.neverProfile.message: Delete your posts or change your profile
connect.neverProfile.description: Something the app can't do here.

connect.optional.message: Optional. You can switch this off.
connect.optional.description: Under a permission the person can turn off.

connect.techApp.description: Label of the app's address in the technical details.

connect.busy.description: What the Connect button says while it works.

connect.verified.message: {provider} has checked this request comes from {domain}. You can disconnect {app} at any time in your account settings on {provider}.
connect.verified.description: Under the buttons: the request is verified.

connect.ready.description: Heading of the short Connect page, when the app hosts the account.

connect.readyLede.message: {app} hosts it, so you can use it with {app} straight away.

connect.whatAppCan.message: What {app} can do with your account
connect.whatAppCan.description: Summary of the permissions on the short Connect page.

connect.continue.description: Button on the short Connect page.

connect.oneAccount.message: It’s one account for {app}, Bluesky and every other Atmosphere app, so you can use it to sign in to all of them.
connect.oneAccount.description: Under the button on the short Connect page.

connect.cancelled.message: You didn’t connect your Atmosphere account, so you’re not signed in. Try again whenever you like.
connect.cancelled.description: Shown in the app after Connect is cancelled.

connect.returning.description: Shown while returning to the app.

provider.footApp.message: This is {app}’s account hosting, separate from the app. Your Atmosphere account works in every Atmosphere app, whoever hosts it.
provider.footApp.description: Footer of the provider page when the app hosts the account itself. {app} is the app's name.
